jobs.occupation: ORM / Social Media Manager (all genders) (Social-Media-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Your creative fieldWe are looking for a full-time, permanent ORM / Social Media Manager to start as soon as possible. We live remote-first, but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations (Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, Munich).

As our new ORM / Social Media Manager , you will be the person who makes Contabo's shift from an affordable VPS provider to a reliable, AI ready, developer friendly infrastructure brand real, in the exact communities where developers, DevOps engineers, and AI practitioners actually talk. You build that credibility from the ground up, combining daily community intelligence with real commercial content production.

Every day, you monitor selected online platforms like Reddit or Discord, triaging brand mentions for further action. You also engage proactively wherever technical conversations happen, from tutorials and GPU workload guides to infrastructure tips and genuine participation in technical discussions, always credibility first and aligned with our tone of voice.

Alongside that, you plan and produce our commercial and marketing content, including product launch announcements, promotional posts, competitor positioning, Contabo Black go-to-market content, event content, and repurposed community threads, all planned in a rolling content calendar, in collaboration with other functions in Marketing. You also write and maintain community intervention playbooks, so the whole team knows how to respond before a situation escalates.

On top of the day to day, you get to build our internal advocacy programme from scratch: you identify technically fluent colleagues across Product and Engineering, bring them on board with clear guidelines, and keep them engaged over time, working toward a team of active online and offline advocates.

You report directly to our Head of Creative Marketing, and the monthly picture you build of sentiment, Share of Voice, and platform activity feeds straight into product and marketing decisions, with real visibility all the way up to our CMO. At its core, this role lives at the intersection of protecting our reputation and driving commercial content forward: someone who speaks the language of developers, but thinks like a marketer.

What convinces us Your personality, paired with:
• 5 to 7 years of experience in community management, ORM, social media, or content marketing, ideally with some background in producing commercial or marketing content
• Hands-on experience with ORM or social listening platforms (Brandwatch, Mention, Sprinklr, Peec.ai, or similar), and confidence running sentiment analysis and Share of Voice reporting
• Strong social media content creation skills across platform native formats, from Reddit and Discord to LinkedIn and X, paired with real commercial and marketing content production experience such as product marketing copy, promotional posts, and competitor positioning
• Genuine community management and engagement experience with a developer or tech focused audience, and the analytical ability to turn what you see there into decisions
• Strong communication and conflict handling skills, clear goal and result orientation, and the ability to build and grow a network without formal authority
• A proactive, ownership driven mindset: you handle pressure well, stay customer oriented, and hold yourself to a high-performance bar
• An authentic community voice who shows up as a real person rather than a brand account, thinks commercially about when community presence drives business outcomes, and stays composed under public criticism without escalating situations
• AI fluency beyond basic prompting skills

Should have:
• Experience coordinating events or conferences, and managing an ORM agency or similar external vendor relationship
• Strong strategic thinking, genuine team spirit, and openness to change as the role and priorities evolve
• A natural sense of ownership that extends beyond your core tasks
• Real curiosity about the cloud, hosting, and developer ecosystem, and a habit of following those communities on your own
• Industry experience in cloud infrastructure, hosting, SaaS, or developer tools, ideally with a B2B tech marketing background
• Great Reddit karma

Nice to have:
• Spanish or Portuguese for LATAM coverage, and German language skills, are a plus alongside fluent English (C1+)
• ORM or social listening platform certifications, Google Analytics, or AI, SEO, and GAIO monitoring credentials
• A degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, or a related field, though equivalent practical experience with a solid technical understanding works just as well

We know that you may not currently meet all the requirements. But if you come to us with the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm, we can take off together and make a big difference.

Awesome ProspectsAt Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference.
What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint.

jobs.occupation: Master's Thesis: Multi-Fidelity Propeller Optimization (all genders) (Ingenieur/in - Medizintechnik)
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLEWe are looking for a Master's student to join our growing Aerodynamics team and carry out a thesis project on the development of a multi-fidelity propeller optimization framework for our hybrid-electric eVTOL aircraft. You will help extend an existing automated propeller design workflow - covering geometry generation, meshing, CFD simulation and post-processing - into a full optimization environment that combines fast Blade Element Momentum Theory (BEMT) predictions, high-fidelity CFD, and aeroacoustics prediction.
Your thesis will directly support propeller designs that perform efficiently across hover, transition and forward flight. The thesis takes around six months and is supervised jointly by our Aerodynamics team and the Chair of Aerodynamics and Fluid Mechanics at the Technical University of Munich (TUM).
WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Conduct a literature review on propeller optimization methodologies and multi-fidelity approaches
• Familiarize yourself with two existing frameworks for propeller design optimization: low-fidelity BEMT environment, automated CFD surrogate modeling-based optimization framework
• Integrate aeroacoustics prediction methods, in the form of PSU-WOPWOP, as part of the low-fidelity BEMT framework
• Develop methods and strategies to leverage both frameworks and incorporate them into a combined multi-fidelity optimization framework
• Revise and update the automated geometry generation, CFD simulation execution, and post-processing into a unified workflow
• In the process you will parametrize the propeller design and perform an optimization of a test case eVTOL propeller, generate the pareto-front between efficiency and noise
• Validate low-fidelity predictions against CFD reference solutions
• Conduct optimization studies for representative flight conditions, evaluating solution quality, computational cost and convergence
• Optionally: utilize surrogate models to incorporate feedback from high fidelity model to low fidelity model for improved optimization convergence and acceleration
• Document your methodology and findings in your final thesis report

WHAT YOU BRING
• Are a student of mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, physics or a comparable field, enrolled at TUM and working towards your Master's degree
• Bring familiarity with CAD and CFD software, ideally Siemens NX and Ansys Fluent
• Hold foundational knowledge of aircraft and propulsion aerodynamics
• Have basic knowledge of numerical methods and optimization techniques
• Have strong Python programming skills
• Are able to work independently and collaborate with a team
• Have good written and verbal communication skills in English
• Bring an interest in aeroacoustics and propeller noise prediction

Moreover, it would be helpful if you also
• have prior exposure to Blade Element Momentum Theory or other low-fidelity aerodynamic methods
• have experience with aeroacoustics prediction methods like PSU-WOPWOP
• have experience with HPC-based simulation workflows
• explore the use of surrogate models to accelerate convergence between fidelity levels

WHAT WE OFFER
• Full-scale aerospace engineering, not concept slides
• A 60+ engineer team at Ottobrunn
• Flexible working hours, remote work, and competitive compensation
• Health & wellbeing: subsidized lunch in our canteen
• Office extras: espresso coffee, fresh fruit, and soft drinks, plus regular team and company events, and plenty more once you're on board
